applicableAreas: Building elevation sheets for all 8 proposed buildings
findings.comment: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors are not included on building elevation sheets. Existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) documents overhead utility poles and lines along Valley View Road and crossing the property, but no registered surveyor data for conductor elevations or clearance verification from proposed buildings is provided on elevations.

applicableAreas: All 8 proposed buildings and their relationships to overhead electric line shown on southern property boundary
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections for clearance verification. Overhead utility line (marked OHE) is shown on site plan and landscape plan, but no dimension lines, callouts, or clearance annotations are provided demonstrating compliance with the 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Northern and southern driveway entrances along Valley View Road where overhead electric lines span across the entry points
findings.comment: Driveways do not show minimum vertical clearance verification from lowest point of overhead electric facilities including telecommunications attachments. Grading plan (Sheet 11) shows two driveway entrances (northern entrance west of Building 1 and southern entrance west of Building 8) that cross under the overhead utility line along Valley View Road, but no vertical clearance dimensions, mid-span clearance survey data, or section views are provided demonstrating compliance with the 16-foot minimum (for parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot minimum (for areas with truck traffic) vertical clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Driveway entrances crossing under overhead electric line at western property boundary
findings.comment: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances not provided when existing overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements. Driveway vertical clearances to overhead lines appear marginal based on site plan elevations; no surveyor-verified mid-span clearance data is provided to confirm driveways maintain the required 16-foot or 18-foot minimum vertical clearance from the lowest point of the overhead conductors and any attachments.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along overhead electric line where trees are proposed
findings.comment: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not verified as being from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list. Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows a row of trees planted directly on or immediately adjacent to the overhead electric line (OHE) along the southern boundary. Plant list (Sheet 35) specifies 2 Live Oak and 10 Cedar Elm as shade trees to be planted in this location. These species are not utility-compatible and exceed the 20-foot mature height typically required for utility-compatible trees. No distance clearance dimensions are provided between tree planting locations and the conductor.

Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines. Overhead electric poles and lines exist on the site (documented on existing conditions survey Sheet 4) and construction is proposed; the required 48-hour notification note per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 is absent from the cover sheet and general notes.
